name: CORD-19: COVID-19 Open Research Dataset
description: The COVID-19 Open Research Dataset (CORD-19) is a massive scholarly corpus created by the Allen Institute for AI (AI2) in partnership with the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, Georgetown University's CSET, Microsoft Research, the National Library of Medicine, and the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy (OSTP). Assembled to mobilize natural language processing and information retrieval researchers during the global pandemic, CORD-19 aggregates over 1,000,000 peer-reviewed articles and preprints on COVID-19, SARS-CoV-2, and related coronaviruses, with full text parses for over 400,000 papers. It provides structured JSON document representations including section paragraphs, citation bib entries, and tabular figures.
